_comment: The ImageButton's scenario layer (BasicsScenario.aspx; tests/WebControlsParity/README.md). A snapshot's tags are the mechanisms it covers. The log's request number is kept in view state: a click the browser cancelled leaves it as it was.

steps.name: ImageButton [postdata][postbackevent][command][viewstate] an image clicked: its coordinates, Click, then Command
ImageButton [clientclick] OnClientClick returns false: no request
ImageButton [command][databind] Command bubbled from a repeater item
ImageButton [defaultbutton] Enter in a panel whose DefaultButton is the image
ImageButton [dynamic][postbackevent] a dynamically created image button
ImageButton [visible][viewstate][postbackevent] the image shown before raises Click

steps.value: const i = document.createElement('input'); i.type = 'hidden'; i.name = e.name + '.x'; i.value = 'x'; e.form.appendChild(i);
